# Digital-Mailroom {.page-title}

[DSHB capstone project · American Family Insurance (industry partner)]{.kicker}

## Overview

A capstone with American Family Insurance to improve how documents are read, sorted, and managed. The project looks for ways to cut the cost of AI inference while improving document processing.

<!-- TODO: add a one-sentence problem statement in plain language (what a "mailroom" handles and why cost matters), if cleared by the industry partner. -->

## What I built

- Ten Python packages covering entity extraction, classification, routing, and scalable workflows.
- One LangGraph pipeline that joins legal-document routing, prompt experiments, deterministic scoring, dataset management, and deployment.
- A reproducible Docker environment so results can be rerun end to end.
